Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Pritinker Diwaker,Chief Justice Hon'ble Ashutosh Srivastava,J.
Heard Shri Deeraj Kumar Dwivedi, learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Standing Counsel for the State-respondents.

Present writ petition is preferred for a direction in the nature of certiorari quashing the impugned orders dated 09.12.2022 and 28.04.2023 passed by Regional Nyay Nirnayak Adhikari/ Additional District Magistrate (City), Kanpur Nagar and also prayed for a writ of Mandamus directing the respondent authority not to take any coercive measures against the petitioner's firm.
It appears from the record that the proceedings were drawn against the petitioner under the Food Safety & Standards (Packaging & Labelling) Regulation, 2011 wherein the order has been passed on Deepak Khanna vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 23 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/180499688/
1 09.12.2022 with a fine of Rs. 1,00,000/-.

entities.text: Regional Nyay Nirnayak Adhikari/ Additional District Magistrate (City), Kanpur Nagar
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Deepak Khanna vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Against this, the petitioner has preferred an appeal wherein the notice has been issued.

Learned counsel for the petitioner sates that even though the petitioner has preferred statutory appeal along with stay application, neither the stay application has been disposed of nor the appeal has been heard on merit and meanwhile the respondents are pressing the recovery.
Learned Standing Counsel raised an objection that in the present matter a case was also registered as Case Crime No. 83 of 2021 under Section 420 of IPC and Section 63 of Copyright Act.

Moreover,
once the petitioner has already invoked the alternative remedy and the matter is seized before the appellate authority, no interference is required under Article 226 of the Constitution of India.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and without adverting on the merits of the case,
we dispose of the writ petition asking the appellate authority to consider the stay application in accordance with law within two weeks from the date of production of certified copy of this order and also make an endeavour to decide the appeal expeditiously.
For a period of two weeks or till the disposal of stay application, whichever is earlier, the respondents are restrained to realise the fine in question.
